title: Unable to migrate from Neo4j 5.5.0 to Neo4j 5.12.0
body:
I'm unable to migrate from Neo4j 5.5.0 to Neo4j 5.12.0

I faced the following issue: https://github.com/neo4j-contrib/neo4j-apoc-procedures/issues/3751

Also, I'm encountering the following issue: 

```
org.neo4j.driver.exceptions.DatabaseException: Access to record Node[1648,used=false,created=false,rel=-1,prop=-1,labels=Inline(0x0:[]),light,fixedRefs=false] went out of bounds of the page. The record size is 15 bytes, and the access was at offset 150 bytes into page 3, and the pages have a capacity of 8192 bytes. The mapped store file in question is /data/databases/neo4j/neostore.nodestore.db

```

I do not have such issues with Neo4j 5.5.0

**Steps to reproduce:**

Please start the following database with Neo4j 5.12.0 Community Edition. I run it in Docker.

[data.zip](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/files/12774362/data.zip)

database username: neo4j
database  password: neo4j12345

ans execute the following query:

```
MATCH  ( childD:Profile )  WITH collect({`childD`: childD}) as childDDgRdgd  
CALL apoc.cypher.mapParallel2(" WITH _.childD as childD WHERE  (childD.`active` = $active0)  AND  (childD.`minInfoProvided` = $minInfoProvided1)  AND  (childD.`status` = $status2)  WITH childD RETURN childD  ", {`active0`:<nick>, `status2`:'APPROVED', `minInfoProvided1`:<nick>}, childDDgRdgd, 6, 10) YIELD value as value   
WITH value.childD as childD   
WITH childD  
WITH collect({`childD`:childD }) as aggregate WITH aggregate, size(aggregate) as count 
UNWIND aggregate as item 
WITH count, item.childD as childD  
ORDER BY childD.createdAt DESC SKIP 0 LIMIT 5 
OPTIONAL MATCH (childD)-[ru:CREATED_BY]->(u:User)  
RETURN count, childD AS decision
```

You should receive:

`Failed to invoke procedure `apoc.cypher.mapParallel2`: Caused by: java.lang.RuntimeException: Error polling, timeout of 10 seconds reached.`

If not, reexecute the query until this error occurs.

Regarding:

`org.neo4j.driver.exceptions.DatabaseException: Access to record Node[1648,used=false,created=false,rel=-1,prop=-1,labels=Inline(0x0:[]),light,fixedRefs=false] went out of bounds of the page. The record size is 15 bytes, and the access was at offset 150 bytes into page 3, and the pages have a capacity of 8192 bytes. The mapped store file in question is /data/databases/neo4j/neostore.nodestore.db`

I don't know how to reliably reproduce this. it occasionally crashes during program execution.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hello and thanks for reporting!

I was not able to reproduce the `Access to record` exception. You provided the client-side stacktrace, could you see if you can find the exception in the `debug.log` instead? That would help me pinpoint the issue.

On a side note, `apoc.cypher.mapParallel2` is part of apoc extended which might not be fully stable. The exception does not make a lot of sense, it complains that offset 150 is outside of the page that has a size of 8192, which is definitively within bounds. I'm suspecting this could happen if there is concurrent access to the internal node reader.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Hello, thank you for your reply!

Sure, I'll try to collect logs. Could you please tell me on how to enable debug logs on the new Neo4j instance?

Regarding `apoc.cypher.mapParallel2`, the only difference in my test setup was the Neo4j version and APOC core/extended versions. With Neo4j 5.5.0, I never encountered such an issue.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
The logs are located in `logs/debug.log` and on by default.

APOC has received a great number of changes as well since 5.5.0, you can find everything here: https://github.com/neo4j-contrib/neo4j-apoc-procedures/releases
